question: How many female superheroes with blue eyes have both the superpower 'Agility' and a Strength attribute value of at least 85?

prediction.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.XCL_018)
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN gender AS g ON s.XCL_021 = g.XCL_007
JOIN colour AS c ON s.XCL_022 = c.XCL_005
JOIN hero_power AS hp ON s.XCL_018 = hp.XCL_012
JOIN superpower AS sp ON hp.XCL_013 = sp.XCL_030
JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON s.XCL_018 = ha.XCL_009
JOIN attribute AS a ON ha.XCL_010 = a.XCL_003
WHERE g.XCL_008 = 'Female'
  AND c.XCL_006 = 'Blue'
  AND sp.XCL_031 = 'Agility'
  AND a.XCL_004 = 'Strength'
  AND ha.XCL_011 >= 85
